patterns.message: Import the database client only in src/db/repository.ts (CLAUDE.md rule 2) — everything else reaches the database through a service, and writes go through withAudit(session, fn). The handful of files that legitimately need a client rather than a writer carry an oxlint-disable-next-line saying why.

Build queries only in src/db/repository.ts (CLAUDE.md rule 4) — a Drizzle query cannot be built without importing drizzle-orm at runtime, so this is that rule rather than a style. Reach the database through a service; `import type` is allowed everywhere, which is how the GraphQL layer names Drizzle types (DESIGN.md §7).

Import the database client only in src/db/repository.ts (CLAUDE.md rule 2) — everything else reaches the database through a service, and writes go through withAudit(session, fn). The handful of files that legitimately need a client rather than a writer carry an oxlint-disable-next-line saying why.
